Our story – 6 practices Watch Our Mission Our Story Confident Med Spa was founded with a simple belief: everyone deserves to feel confident in their own skin. Founded in 2022, what started as a single location in Epping, NH has grown into a network of 6 clinics across New Hampshire and Maine, plus a Virtual Telehealth practice covering all of NH & ME. With partners including Allergan Aesthetics, ZO Skin Health, Cartessa Aesthetics, Hydrafacial, Prollenium, and Biote — all built on the same foundation of personalized care, clinical excellence, and genuine human connection. Our Standards By fostering a culture of excellence around our patient experience and clinically proven medical services, we’ve attracted a best-in-class team trained in the safest, most effective treatment protocols. Every provider completes hundreds of hours of training through our in-house Training Academy. We are LegitScript-certified, HIPAA-compliant, and physician-supervised at every location. Over 1,000 5-star Google reviews between all of our locations and an average 5.0 star rating on Google reflects the consistent quality our patients experience. Our Promise We listen first. Every treatment plan starts with understanding your unique goals, concerns, and lifestyle. We don’t push unnecessary treatments — we guide you toward the options that will make the biggest difference for you. Your confidence is our measure of success. Featured on CBS 13 News Chelsea Laughton, President and Co-Founder of Confident Med Spa, joined CBS 13 News to share expert summer skincare tips, discuss the importance of protecting your skin, and highlight Confident Med Spa’s continued expansion into Maine.
